title: Letter Combinations of a Phone Number
prompt: Given a string containing digits from 2-9 inclusive, return all possible letter combinations that the number could represent. Return the answer in any order. A mapping of digits to letters (just like on the telephone buttons) is given below. Note that 1 does not map to any letters.
constraints: digits[i] is a digit in the range ['2', '9'].
hints: Map each digit to its letters: 2->abc, 3->def, etc. Backtrack: for each digit, try each letter, recurse on next digit.
Base: if we've processed all digits, add current string to result.
For each letter of digits[i], append, recurse(i+1), remove.
O(4^n) - each digit has up to 4 letters.
